note: Historical Nordic crypto news, one file per publication year, back to 2009. Researchers add articles. Scientific works are not copied here: the archive page and /api/v1/archive/news/page-N.json read master's theses, project theses and papers from data/academia.json (the same rows as /academia/). There is no /db/ directory in this repo; this file is the storage contract, in the same JSON-collection style as data/books.json and data/talks.json.

file.year: Integer. Must match the file name, for example 2013.json.
file.articles: Array of article objects. May be empty.

article.id: Stable string, unique across every year file.
article.title: Headline as published by the source.
article.title_en: Our English headline, or null when title is already that headline.
article.title_i18n: Object of site language codes to our headline. Same codes as a news item: nn, nb, sv, da, fi, is. English stays in title_en.
article.source: Outlet id, or the outlet name when there is no id.
article.source_name: Outlet name shown to readers. Optional; source is used when this is empty.
article.archive_url: https URL of an archived copy (for example a library or Wayback snapshot), or null.
article.published: ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone, the time the source published.
article.country: NO, SE, DK, FI, IS, FO, GL, AX, NORDIC or EU.
article.language: Source language, using the same names as news items when they fit: Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, English.
article.summary_i18n: Object of nn, nb, sv, da, fi, is to a published translation of summary. Omit a language until a translation exists.
